package probe

import "os/exec"

// *exec.Cmd is allowed only as the whole type of a struct field, a function
// parameter, a function result or a var (pointer_cmd.go.txt). It is refused as
// the element or key of an array, slice, map or chan type, on the right of a
// type declaration, and as a type argument, so no composite value can hold a
// command (P2). Each shape is one finding, at the type expression.
var sliceOfCmds []*exec.Cmd
var nestedSliceOfCmds [][]*exec.Cmd
var mapOfCmds map[*exec.Cmd]int
var mapOfSlicesOfCmds map[string][]*exec.Cmd
var chanOfCmds chan *exec.Cmd

type cmds []*exec.Cmd
type cmdPointer = *exec.Cmd

// cmdList is a generic type, not a function: the type argument below is the
// only thing the type rule has to say about it.
type cmdList[T any] []T

func cmdListArgument() {
	_ = cmdList[*exec.Cmd]{}
}
